# byte-order mark, with the format declaration on the line BELOW it. The
# declaration is only ever read from line 1, so this file is damaged and both
# readers must refuse it by line number: a reader that stops scanning the header
# because the BOM made line 1 look like an entry would call it a healthy legacy
# store while the other blocks every commit. Values are reserved-documentation
# or persona-derived only.
